# Command reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_docs.py — do not edit by hand. -->

Every command is available in English and Farsi; the description shown here is
the English catalog text. Commands marked **owner only** are refused for any
account other than the logged-in user.

`.` in the usage column stands for the active prefix (default `.`).


Total: **75 commands**.


## Ai

| Command | Description | Usage | Aliases |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `.ai` | Every AI model and key, with today's budgets _(owner only)._ | `.ai [model <n|name|auto>|key [add <key>|rm <label>]|test|reset]` | `.models`, `.model`, `.keys` |

## Notes

- Automation features are **off by default**; enable them with `.feature <name> on`.
- `--yes` skips the confirmation prompt for state-changing commands.
- Dry-run (`.dryrun on`) previews state-changing commands without applying them.
- The emergency stop (`.stop`) freezes commands, automation and scheduled work.
